name: mingli-bench-harness
description: Evaluation harness that runs an AI agent against MingLi-Bench (Bazi (Chinese astrology) multiple-choice questions) with majority-vote scoring, trimmed means, cost tracking and a results report.

scripts.score:published: node --import tsx src/cli.ts --score --in results/published/kimi-k2.5-2025x5.jsonl --rounds 5 && node --import tsx src/cli.ts --score --in results/published/kimi-k2.5-all.jsonl --rounds 1
